dossier.purpose: React (https://github.com/react/react) is a Yarn-classic monorepo for a JavaScript UI library. It publishes the core `react` package, the DOM and server renderers (`react-dom`: client roots plus Fizz streaming SSR), the reconciler and scheduler, React Server Components bindings (`react-server-dom-webpack|turbopack|parcel`), an ESLint plugin and other tooling. It also holds React DevTools (browser extensions, an Electron CLI, a WebSocket core), a separate `compiler/` workspace (TypeScript Babel plugin plus an in-progress Rust port) and two experimental AI-tool packages (`react-devtools-cdt-mcp`, `react-mcp-server`). It is a UI library and its tooling. No Dockerfile, Compose file or other container-engine artifact exists in the repo. Revision check: .git/packed-refs:2 maps refs/tags/v19.3.0 to 1d34f91dfde6bba84d08b683aaba164c7194dacb and .git/HEAD:1 is the same commit; the clone is shallow (.git/shallow).

claims.claim: 'React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces.'

Declarative and component-based; 'Learn Once, Write Anywhere: We don't make assumptions about the rest of your technology stack... React can also render on the server using Node and power mobile apps using React Native.'

Gradual adoption: 'you can use as little or as much React as you need'. The Installation section is three links to react.dev (Quick Start, Add React to an Existing Project, Create a New React App); the README itself contains no install command.
Documentation is on the website (react.dev); docs improvements go to the separate repo reactjs/react.dev.
Docs repo pointer: 'You can improve it by sending pull requests to this repository (https://github.com/reactjs/react.dev)'.
Example: createRoot from 'react-dom/client' renders a HelloMessage component into a page container.
JSX is not required to use React.
'Development of React happens in the open on GitHub'; contributing guide, code of conduct and good-first-issues are external links.
CI badges reference the workflows '(Runtime) Build and Test' and '(Compiler) TypeScript'; npm version badge for `react`.
Absence: the README (79 lines, read in full) says nothing about Docker/containers/Compose, multi-service orchestration, deployment, supported platforms, telemetry, TypeScript types or security.

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry or phone-home code found in the core runtime (react, react-dom, scheduler, react-reconciler, react-server, react-client, react-server-dom-*): searches for fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket/sendBeacon and Node http/https/net imports hit only comments, caller-supplied streams (optional WebSocket debug channel typing, packages/react-server-dom-webpack/src/server/ReactFlightDOMServerNode.js:152) or DevTools code. Production error messages only contain a https://react.dev/errors/<code> URL string (packages/shared/formatProdErrorMessage.js:14). DevTools: the event logger is compiled out of OSS builds (enableLogger = false in packages/react-devtools-shared/src/config/DevToolsFeatureFlags.default.js:17, DevToolsFeatureFlags.extension-oss.js:17, DevToolsFeatureFlags.core-oss.js:17; true only in the -fb variants) and also needs a build-time LOGGING_URL (packages/react-devtools-core/webpack.standalone.js:28; packages/react-devtools-shared/src/registerDevToolsEventLogger.js:66-89). The `react-devtools` CLI runs update-notifier on a 7-day interval (packages/react-devtools/bin.js:16-30). The DevTools error boundary queries https://api.github.com/search/issues with the error message (packages/react-devtools-shared/src/devtools/views/ErrorBoundary/githubAPI.js:15-53; cache.js:91). The standalone server is HTTP + WebSocket on localhost:8097 by default with no auth step in the connection handler (packages/react-devtools-core/src/standalone.js:328-364,383-410; packages/react-devtools/README.md:90-102). The experimental react-mcp-server calls Algolia and fetches react.dev pages (compiler/packages/react-mcp-server/src/utils/algolia.ts:12-16,101-105), launches Chrome via Puppeteer with scripts loaded from unpkg (src/tools/runtimePerf.ts:95,208-210) and attaches to Chrome at 127.0.0.1:9222 (src/tools/componentTree.ts:5-8). The compiler playground build downloads fonts from conf.reactjs.org (compiler/apps/playground/scripts/downloadFonts.js:12-20) and is deployed on Vercel (compiler/apps/playground/README.md:36-42). Accounts: none needed to use the npm libraries; maintainer-side accounts are npm (OIDC in a protected `npm` environment for runtime releases; NPM_TOKEN secret for compiler prereleases), crates.io (OIDC), a Discord webhook secret, and a GitHub token for `yarn download-build` (scripts/release/shared-commands/download-build-artifacts.js:10-22).

code.architecture: Renderer-agnostic core plus pluggable host configs, bundled per environment. packages/react (index.js, src/ReactHooks.js) defines components, hooks and JSX runtimes. packages/react-reconciler (ReactFiberWorkLoop.js, ReactFiberHooks.js, ReactFiberBeginWork.js, ReactFiberCommitWork.js; host interface ReactFiberConfig.js) with packages/scheduler (src/forks/Scheduler.js) powers the client renderers: packages/react-dom + react-dom-bindings (createRoot in react-dom/src/client/ReactDOMRoot.js; DOM host config react-dom-bindings/src/client/ReactFiberConfigDOM.js), react-native-renderer (Fabric), react-art, react-test-renderer, react-noop-renderer. Server side: packages/react-server implements Fizz streaming SSR (ReactFizzServer.js) and Flight/RSC (ReactFlightServer.js, ReactFlightReplyServer.js for server-function request decoding) with per-runtime stream configs (ReactServerStreamConfig{Node,Edge,Browser,Bun}.js); packages/react-client holds the Flight client (ReactFlightClient.js); packages/react-server-dom-{webpack,turbopack,parcel,esm,unbundled,fb} are bundler-specific RSC bindings. react-server, react-client, react-dom-bindings, react-native-renderer and shared are private workspace packages (private:true) bundled into published artifacts. scripts/shared/inlinedHostConfigs.js lists 24 host-config targets (dom-browser/node/edge/bun, fabric, art, test, noop, custom, ...); scripts/rollup/{build.js,bundles.js} emit dev/prod/profiling/ESM bundles per channel (stable, experimental, www, RN). Tooling packages: react-devtools-* (shared UI/backend, Chrome/Firefox/Edge extensions, Electron CLI, core WebSocket server/backend, inline/fusebox embeds, facade + cdt-mcp), eslint-plugin-react-hooks (TypeScript, embeds React Compiler analysis), react-refresh. compiler/ is a separate Yarn + Cargo workspace: packages/babel-plugin-react-compiler (TypeScript HIR pipeline), crates/* (Rust port, documented as active work in compiler/CLAUDE.md:239-252), react-compiler-runtime, react-compiler-healthcheck, react-forgive (VS Code LSP), react-mcp-server, snap (fixture runner) and apps/playground (Next.js).
code.packaging_and_release: Artifacts: npm packages built by Rollup (plus Closure Compiler for non-ESM production bundles) per release channel - oss-stable (canary versions), oss-stable-semver (@latest), oss-experimental, facebook-www, facebook-react-native (scripts/rollup/build-all-release-channels.js:179-329; scripts/rollup/build.js:375-379,462-475). The publish allow-list is ReactVersions.js:3-6,35-56 (react, react-dom, scheduler, react-reconciler, react-is, react-refresh, react-art, react-test-renderer, use-subscription, use-sync-external-store, jest-react, eslint-plugin-react-hooks, react-server-dom-webpack/turbopack/parcel; react-markup experimental only). CI uploads `artifacts_combined` (build.tgz, build2.tgz) and attests it with actions/attest-build-provenance@v2 on pushes to main/releases/** and same-repo PRs (.github/workflows/runtime_build_and_test.yml:563-593). Release workflow runtime_release_from_ci.yml: weekday cron (16:10) nightly canary+experimental, or manual stable-latest / stable-backport / experimental_only; the publish job sits behind the protected `npm` environment, uses OIDC (id-token: write), Node 24 and accepts no user-supplied ref (lines 42-45,108-198). scripts/release/prepare-release-from-ci.js downloads the CI artifact and runs `gh attestation verify` unless --noVerify (scripts/release/shared-commands/download-build-artifacts.js:99-111; the guard `executableIsAvailable('gh')` at :103 is async and not awaited, so it is always truthy). scripts/release/publish-commands/publish-to-npm.js runs `npm publish --tag <tag>` per package (:34-41, no explicit --provenance flag). No checksum or signature files (GPG/cosign), GitHub Releases or container images are produced by any workflow or script found; the 'checksum' in scripts/release/utils.js:89-96 is a 7-char hash of packages/ written into build-info.json. Separate pipelines: compiler npm packages (babel-plugin-react-compiler, react-compiler-healthcheck, react-compiler-runtime) published with an NPM_TOKEN secret (.github/workflows/compiler_prereleases.yml:25-35,62-68; compiler/scripts/release/shared/packages.js:8-12); Rust crates to crates.io via OIDC (compiler_rust_publish.yml:26-42); react-devtools-cdt-mcp via OIDC (devtools_cdt_mcp_publish.yml:1-4,51-86); DevTools npm packages published manually with an npm OTP prompt and extension-store uploads by hand (scripts/devtools/publish-release.js:36-112). Build output is also committed to builds/facebook-www and builds/facebook-fbsource branches (runtime_commit_artifacts.yml:209-310).
code.tests_and_ci: Frameworks: Jest 30 with jest-circus (package.json:87,139-143; scripts/jest/config.base.js:27,46) driven by scripts/jest/jest-cli.js (release channels stable/experimental/www-classic/www-modern/xplat, dev/prod env, variants, persistent mode, --build for built bundles, devtools project: lines 36-60); Flow per renderer config (package.json:145-146); ESLint and Prettier; Playwright (fixtures/flight, DevTools extension e2e, react-devtools-cdt-mcp e2e, compiler playground); compiler snapshot runner `snap` plus Jest and Cargo. Test dirs: packages/*/src/__tests__ and packages/*/__tests__ (testRegex matches files directly inside any __tests__ dir, config.base.js:26-27), scripts/*/__tests__, compiler/packages/*/src/__tests__ (plus 1,813 compiler snapshot fixture inputs under babel-plugin-react-compiler/src/__tests__/fixtures), compiler/crates/*/tests/*.rs, compiler/apps/playground/__tests__, fixtures/* apps. Approximate count: ~361 files directly in packages/**/__tests__ (about 310 *-test.js/ts plus about 48 *-test.internal.js, a few helpers), 5 under scripts/, 6 compiler *-test.ts unit tests, 4 Rust integration-test files. CI: 26 workflow files in .github/workflows, every job runs on ubuntu-latest, most set `permissions: {}` by default. (Runtime) Build and Test (push to main/releases/**, PRs not touching compiler/**, manual; runtime_build_and_test.yml:7-20): Flow per host config, generated-Fizz-runtime check, feature-flag check, `yarn test` (18 parameter sets x 5 shards), eslint-plugin-react-hooks tests, 25-worker x 2-channel `yarn build` + lint-build, `yarn test --build` (4 sets x 10 shards), DevTools build tests, provenance attestation, error-code and release-dependency checks, DOM and Flight fixture tests, DevTools extension builds (chrome/firefox/edge) + e2e, cdt-mcp e2e, sizebot. Other workflows: shared_lint (prettier, eslint, PATENTS/license check, print-warnings), runtime_eslint_plugin_e2e (ESLint 6-10 fixtures), runtime_fuzz_tests (hourly cron + main), devtools_regression_tests (daily), compiler_typescript (lint, Jest, per-workspace tests), compiler_rust (cargo check/build, Rust-port tests, snap --rust), compiler_playground (Playwright), plus release/publish, artifact-commit, Discord-notify and cache/stale housekeeping. Benchmark harnesses exist (scripts/bench, fixtures/flight-ssr-bench) but no results are checked in.

risks: Scope: the repo defines no container or Compose tooling - no Dockerfile, compose file, Containerfile or devcontainer; the only 'docker' string is a CircleCI image in packages/react-devtools-extensions/.circleci/config.yml:8-10. Local multi-process fixtures are started with yarn + concurrently (fixtures/flight/package.json:75-80), and the only documented deployment is the Vercel-hosted compiler playground (compiler/apps/playground/README.md:36-42). Nothing here defines or runs a multi-service application on a container engine.

Typed usage: library source is Flow-typed (isFlowTyped in scripts/shared/inlinedHostConfigs.js) and no TypeScript declarations ship for react, react-dom, scheduler, react-reconciler or react-server-dom-* (no `types` field: packages/react/package.json:11-52). Only eslint-plugin-react-hooks, react-compiler-runtime and babel-plugin-react-compiler-rust declare types (packages/eslint-plugin-react-hooks/package.json:33; compiler/packages/react-compiler-runtime/package.json:7; compiler/packages/babel-plugin-react-compiler-rust/package.json:6). The playground consumes separate @types/react packages (compiler/apps/playground/package.json:49-50).

Server-side surface: CHANGELOG.md:1-42 lists seven consecutive patch releases (19.2.1 Dec 2025 to 19.2.7 Jun 2026) containing only React Server Components / Server Actions fixes, several described as DoS mitigation, cycle or loop protection; request-decoding limits are hard-coded constants (packages/react-server/src/ReactFlightReplyServer.js:149-160,1913-1921). The react-server and react-server-dom-webpack READMEs say 'Use it at your own risk' (packages/react-server/README.md:3-7; packages/react-server-dom-webpack/README.md:3-5) while react-server-dom-webpack/turbopack/parcel are in the stable publish list (ReactVersions.js:41-43).
